entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: IE that the UE includes to request the network to restrict paging when specific conditions are met in the UE request type IE.

entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: Information element containing the Request type field that indicates the type of UE request.

entities.name: Request type is NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Condition where the Request type field in UE request type IE is set to NAS signalling connection release.

entities.name: Request type is Rejection of paging
entities.description: Condition where the Request type field in UE request type IE is set to Rejection of paging.

entities.name: UE requests network to restrict paging
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE is requesting the network to restrict paging.

relations.description: The UE request type IE can have its Request type field set to NAS signalling connection release.
The UE request type IE can have its Request type field set to Rejection of paging.
When Request type is NAS signalling connection release and UE requests paging restriction, the UE shall include the Paging restriction IE.
When Request type is Rejection of paging and UE requests paging restriction, the UE shall include the Paging restriction IE.
When the UE requests the network to restrict paging, the UE shall include the Paging restriction IE.
